item.title: 7 Spring Lawn Care Mistakes That Cause Brown Patches All Summer
item.description: When you’re looking forward to a green lawn to enjoy all summer, it’s incredibly frustrating to notice brown patches popping up. Unfortunately, a lot of the mistakes that cause these patches start in spring. Gardening expert Madison Moulton explains what to avoid.

item.title: Why Your Potting Soil Keeps Killing Plants (5 Red Flags to Watch For)
item.description: If your potted plants keep dying, don’t assume you have a black thumb. Your potting soil may be the problem. Gardening expert Madison Moulton explains the potting soil red flags to look out for.

item.title: 7 Shade Flowers That Bloom All Summer Long
item.description: Can flowers in the shade bloom all summer? Yes, they certainly can! There are plenty of perennials that show off in summer, even where full sun isn’t present. Experienced gardener Sarah Jay has seven of the most stunning shade flowers you can grow in your garden this year.

item.title: 7 Best Flowering Vines You Can Grow From Seed
item.description: Growing flowering vines is like adding ‘wallpaper’ to your garden, completely enclosing the space in blooms. Many offer wonderful scents too, engaging all the senses. Gardening expert Madison Moulton lists the best flowering vines to grow from seed.

item.title: How to Start a Container Orchard in Small Spaces
item.description: If you think you can’t grow fruits in small garden spaces, think again. It’s possible to start an entire orchard in pots alone, delivering delicious harvests without ever planting anything in the ground. Follow this guide to find out how.

item.title: 7 Beautiful Perennials for New England Gardens
item.description: New England perennials enliven gardens and support the local ecosystem at the same time. Include a few of these in your garden if you live in one of the states that make up this American region. If you’re not sure which perennials to start with, follow along as experienced gardener and Master Naturalist Sarah Jay outlines seven of the best ones you can grow.

item.title: How to Plant, Grow, and Care for Chestnut Mushrooms
item.description: Chestnut mushrooms add a nutty, peppery, and mildly sweet flavor profile to dishes, but they’re usually only available in specialty stores. Thankfully, you can easily grow your own at home, either in a kit or in hardwood logs. Experienced gardener, Sarah Jay, discusses how to do it here.

item.title: How to Plant, Grow, and Care for Nikau Palm Trees
item.description: The Nikau palm is an ideal choice for tropical-inspired gardens, but this New Zealand native has specific needs that differ from typical palms. Gardening expert Madison Moulton explains how to grow healthy and happy Nikau palms.

item.title: 7 Azalea Diseases: Prevention and Treatment
item.description: Azaleas don’t have many disease problems. However, when they do, it’s important to deal with them as soon as possible. Gardening expert Madison Moulton lists the diseases and how to prevent or treat them.
